Frosted tips. Boy band formations. That heartthrob energy that lived rent-free in your middle school diary. 💿💘

Cherry Pop is bringing Teen Heart Throb to Azucar — an ALL Kings drag show stacked with Bieber, Timberlake, Backstreet Boys, and Big Time Rush tributes. We're talking synchronized steps, boy band poses, and enough nostalgia to make you text your middle school crush. This is not a drill, mi gente.

Cherry Pop hosts, the Kings bring the fantasy, and la pista does the rest. Mark it, set a reminder, tell your group chat — this is the one you don't sleep on.

📅 Sunday, November 15th • Doors 7PM | Show 8PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🎟️ $10

The lights hit, the beat drops, and suddenly you're 13 again staring at a boy band poster. 🎤✨

Teen Heart Throb turns Azucar into a time machine — Kings serving Bieber swagger, Timberlake smoothness, Backstreet Boys harmonies, and Big Time Rush chaos, all under one roof. Cherry Pop hosts the madness, the formations hit, the lip syncs hit harder, and la pista turns into your middle school dance floor fever dream.

Feel the bass in your chest. Feel the nostalgia in your bones. This is the kind of night where you scream the lyrics even if you swore you forgot them.

Come for the glam, stay for the chaos, leave humming boy band hits till next Sunday.

No matter who your diary crush was, there's a King serving that energy this Sunday. 💌🫶

Teen Heart Throb is for everybody who ever had a poster on their wall — Bieber era, Timberlake era, Backstreet Boys era, Big Time Rush era, doesn't matter. Cherry Pop hosts a night built for the whole crew: come solo, bring your ride-or-die, pull up with the whole squad. Azucar is the spot where every fan, every vibe, every outfit gets its moment.

Dress like it's your favorite throwback era or just come as you are — la pista doesn't judge, it just wants you dancing. This is Latinx nightlife at its most fun: loud, loving, and full of nostalgia nobody's too cool to admit they still feel.

Bring your people. Bring your boy band energy. Let's go.
